title: Finite scalar compatibility for an open quotient
statement:
For an integral open operation o on j:U→X, there is a family of isomorphisms, one for every n,
finiteExtension l E j o n ⋙ scalarReductionRestriction l E X n ≅
scalarReductionRestriction l E U n ⋙ IntegralOpenReduction.extension l E j o.

source.place: Tags 03DI and 0E8I; identity on extension-by-zero summands and scalar projection equations.

proof.text:
At each finite coefficient level, identify the two functors on extension-by-zero generators by the
identity on the summand section. The scalar projection equations of o make this identification linear,
and sheafification and the open adjunction extend it uniquely and naturally to an isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem openQuotientScalarFiniteCompatibility
    (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E j) :
    Nonempty (∀ n : ℕ,
      IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtension l E j o n ⋙ scalarReductionRestriction l E X n ≅
        scalarReductionRestriction l E U n ⋙ IntegralOpenReduction.extension l E j o)
